description: The Department for Environment and Water publishes a South Australian stormwater nodes layer derived from a 2005 dataset and later council updates. The provider warns that some council areas have not been updated since 2005. Its description identifies twelve councils included in the 2009 update, including Charles Sturt, Gawler and Salisbury. The nodes describe drainage network assets that can support stormwater-flow model construction alongside the companion drains layer. Node elevations, dimensions and connections have not been checked. Data.SA lists Shapefile, GeoJSON and compressed KML distributions under CC BY 4.0, with public access. Only catalogue metadata and file headers were inspected. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and observation currency remain unverified. The Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
